address: 1827 Dian Street, Makati - Metro Manila, The Philippines
bio: This roadside stall shaded by a tree has built up a following for its pancit batil patung, made to order in a small pot. In the standout lodi, the yolk of the soft-boiled egg ties together the miki noodles and crispy pork belly. The flavourful complimentary egg drop soup is the perfect match.
